editor.label: Map
editor.description: A world of another map is kept: switching back loads it again.

editor.label: Description
editor.description: Shown in the server details of the server list.

editor.label: Map difficulty
editor.description: Strength and health of NPCs and animals.

editor.label: Admin SteamID64s
editor.description: Steam64 ids of the server admins, separated by semicolons (;). Admins open the GM panel in the game.

editor.label: Welcome message
editor.description: Shown to each player who joins. Empty = no message.

editor.label: Harvest multiplier (PvE)
editor.description: Plants, hunting and stone on a PvE server.

editor.label: Workshop mods
editor.description: Mod folders separated by +, e.g. Mods/1234567890 (relative to MOE/Binaries/Win64). Installing or removing a mod on the Steam Workshop page updates this list.

script.name: Save the world and shut down
script.description: Saves the world over RCON (saveworld), asks the server to shut down (ShutDownServer) and waits until it exits.

script.name: Save the world
Add the Workshop mod to the mod list
script.description: Moves the downloaded mod to MOE/Binaries/Win64/Mods/<id> and adds it to the Workshop mods variable (-SteamModList).

script.name: Remove the Workshop mod from the mod list
script.description: Removes the mod from the Workshop mods variable and deletes MOE/Binaries/Win64/Mods/<id>.

script.name: Query
script.description: Status, map and players from the Steam query (A2S) on the query port, with the server name and slots of the service (the game reports its Steam id as the name).

script.name: Prepare the server
script.description: Removes the folders of Workshop mods that were uninstalled while the server was running.
